name: Django
metaTitle: Django Development Services for SaaS and AI Products
description: Techlio builds and modernizes secure web platforms, internal admin portals, and multi-tenant SaaS backends with Django and AI integrations.
h1: Django platforms and APIs, *ready for AI features.*
answer: Django is a Python web framework for building secure, data-driven applications quickly. Techlio uses it for SaaS back ends, internal tools and APIs, and for adding AI features to products already built on Python.

builds.title: SaaS back ends and APIs
builds.text: Multi-tenant platforms with authentication, roles, billing hooks and REST APIs.

builds.title: Internal tools and admin
builds.text: Operational dashboards and back-office tools built on Django's admin and ORM.

builds.title: AI features on Django
builds.text: Retrieval, agents and background AI jobs added to an existing Django product.

fits: You want a mature framework with security features built in
The product is data-heavy with complex permissions
Your AI services are in Python and you want one language on the back end

faqs.question: Django or Node.js?
faqs.answer: Both are sound. We choose Django when the product is data-heavy or the team is Python-first, and Node when real-time features or a shared TypeScript codebase matter more.

faqs.question: Can you upgrade an old Django version?
faqs.answer: Yes, in stages with tests, so the system stays in use throughout.

faqs.question: Does Django scale?
faqs.answer: Yes, with the usual practices: caching, background workers, database tuning and horizontal scaling.
